HBB.name: Casgevy (exagamglogene autotemcel)
HBB.approvedFor: Sickle cell disease with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises (FDA approval 8 Dec 2023; age extensions since)
HBB.mechanism: Autologous CD34+ haematopoietic stem cells edited ex vivo with CRISPR-Cas9 at the BCL11A erythroid enhancer, de-repressing fetal haemoglobin (HbF) to counter sickling.
